articles.title: Man City Premier League charges: Kaveh Solhekol answers your questions on appeal, EFL, independent regulator and more
articles.summary: Man City have been found guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules by an independent commission; Sky Sports News' Kaveh Solhekol answers your questions on when an appeal outcome might be released, the EFL, independent regulator and much more...
articles.body:
City continue to deny the breaches and have confirmed they will appeal against the ruling - they have until Friday October 2 to do so.

Answering your questions live on Sky Sports News, the chief correspondent discussed a range of topics, from when there will be an appeal outcome, to a potential drop into the EFL, player contracts and much more.

Read on for his answers in the latest Q&A...

'We should have appeal outcome in new year'

RhydonDN asked: How long is the appeal process expected to take? Could we be in a scenario where Man City appeal and this whole process takes additional months or even years to be resolved?

Solhekol said: "Looking at the Premier League process, City have until Friday to appeal, then that would need to be wrapped by Christmas, I think - 12 weeks.

"We would then get a judgement in 30 days of that 12-week period being over. We will get the judgement of the appeal in the new year and well before the end of the season.

"That five-day appeal will be heard by a new three-person panel.

"But City could try to go to the High Court to argue that the whole Premier League process has been flawed and rigged against them. If they do, then it could run for years and years.

"It's also worth pointing out that the FA could launch an investigation to establish whether any of its rules have been broken by the club or its employees.

"Meanwhile, four clubs have already reserved the right to sue City for compensation - Manchester United, Liverpool, Arsenal and Spurs. Other clubs are likely to seek compensation from City when the Premier League process is over."

Potential punishment and would the EFL accept Man City?

Josh asked: Could the Premier League deduct Man City the maximum amount of points they could earn this season to ensure they are relegated to the EFL?

Secondly, would the EFL accept them into the Championship?

Solhekol said: "What is going to happen is, we will have a sanctions hearing. The same three people who delivered the judgement and were on the original commission will decide what the punishment will be.

"They have a range of options. City could be expelled from the Premier League, could be a points deduction, transfer ban or big fine. We have to wait and find out what the punishment will be.

"If they just get a points deduction, which means they are relegated this season, then I imagine the EFL would accept them.

"If they are expelled, the EFL does not need to necessarily accept them. They would have to apply to be admitted to the EFL and it would be up to the EFL's 72 clubs to decide.

"You would imagine the EFL would want to admit them as City are a big club. Wherever they go, there will be big interest and big support."

Jonty asked: Could the EFL refuse City entry into their system? Where would that leave them?

Solhekol said: "Technically they could. If they are expelled from the Premier League, the EFL may decide they don't want Man City in the EFL, but I don't understand why they would not want City in the EFL."

Would City get parachute payments if they were relegated?

Ash asked: If City are effectively relegated by points deduction, will they receive automatic parachute payments? The mechanics of relegation are set up to support teams not punish them as far as I'm aware. I'd also be keen to know if 2019 onwards will also be investigated.

Solhekol said: "I don't see any reason why they wouldn't receive parachute payments, just like any other club if they were relegated from the Premier League. That is the simple answer."

What role could the Independent Football Regulator play?

Owners test asked: Surely there's something in the owners' charter about this, could they be forced to sell? Could criminal charges happen as they submitted fraudulent accounts?

Solhekol said: "Now we have an Independent Football Regulator; it may well be the case that the regulator takes an interest in this, once the whole process has run its course.

"The regulator could decide to remove directors from their posts at the club and force a change of ownership.

"But again, let's make it clear, City say it is never going to get as far as that because we will prove that we are innocent."

PolarBear asked: Can the independent football regulator force the current owners out?

Solhekol said: "We've had a lot of questions like this and yes, the regulator has the power to force an owner to sell a club, but we are a long way away from the possibility of that happening."

'The evidence submitted only went up to 2018'

Gooner2526 asked: Considering how damning the verdict appears to have been for the seasons 2009/10 to 2017/18, surely the subsequent seasons would warrant investigation next? Why isn't this a topic?

Solhekol said: "I can only assume that the evidence put in front of the tribunal only went up to that season.

"What we do know is a lot of the evidence came in material obtained by a Portuguese hacker, Rui Pinto, who hacked into City's email servers and handed that information on to German magazine Der Spiegel .

"They first reported their investigations in a series of articles that were published in 2018 and that is what promoted UEFA's investigations and also triggered the Premier League's investigation.

"The short answer is - the evidence that was presented to the tribunal only went up to 2018."

'HMRC might take an interest - but we have to wait and see'

Dan asked: The scale of the judgement goes beyond football and suggests that Man City could be guilty of a massive corporate fraud. What is the likelihood of a criminal or regulatory investigation into the evidence of fraud/false accounting by Man City?

Solhekol said: "We have to wait and see. What I do know is that when you file company accounts, you have a legal duty to make sure the financial declarations you make are true and accurate.

"If you fraudulently misrepresent the figures, then you could be charged under the Fraud Act of 2006, and that is a serious issue. I imagine the relevant authorities will be looking at that.

"There's also the possibility that HMRC - the tax man - might take an interest in this as well because we know from what the commission has said that Man City were paying people in a roundabout way off the books.

"That could mean the National Insurance and the tax that had to be paid wasn't paid. But again, that's something we have to wait and see if HMRC take interest in that.

"An investigation from the National Economic Crime Centre could also be launched to see if anyone has dishonestly made false representations under the 2006 Fraud Act. Financial declarations made in annual accounts filed with Companies House have to be true and accurate.

"But Man City still to this day say they have done absolutely nothing wrong and they are very confident that their name will be cleared and their innocence will be established.

Player contracts and potential clauses discussed

MattC asked: If City's punishment is severe - e.g. relegation - would players have a right to cancel their contracts due to the club's irresponsible behaviour?

Solhekol said: "Good question. I don't think you can just rip up your contract but I think you could seek legal advice.

"If you could establish that you signed the contract and the other party to the contract did not make you fully aware of the situation at the club when you signed the contract, then you may be able to walk away from your contract.

"That is something players would need to get legal advice on. It is not something I would totally discount.

"That may or may not have happened [clauses in contracts]. I don't think there would be clauses in the contract about whether, if this judgement goes against us, they can go away [leave].

"No player is going to show me or you their contract."

Why the hearing was conducted in privacy

Matt H asked: Why was the hearing conducted in complete privacy? If it had happened in a High Court, for instance, there would be witnesses, press in attendance and more clarity to what was being said, what was being witnessed and what wasn't being witnessed?

Solhekol said: "This is a point being made by sports lawyers. They say that these proceedings should be open and transparent.

"The issue here is that this is a private matter. Effectively, the Premier League is a very exclusive club, made up of 20 member clubs.

"They have their own rulebook. This is what it says in the rulebook, so why would they open their doors to the likes of you and me to sit in on some very private and confidential proceedings."

articles.title: Arch Manning, Olivia Miles, Tyrese Maxey Among Athletes Named to TIME100 Next 2026 List
articles.summary: TIME has named multiple athletes to its annual list of "the world's most influential rising stars."
articles.body:
TIME has named multiple athletes to its annual list of "the world's most influential rising stars."

Texas quarterback Arch Manning, Minnesota Lynx rookie Olivia Miles and Philadelphia 76ers guard Tyrese Maxey were among those listed Wednesday on the TIME100 Next 2026 .

Other athletes celebrated on the list included USMNT striker Folarin Balogun and WTA No. 18 Alexandra Eala.

Maxey, 25, made the list after averaging a career-high 28.3 points per game in his sixth season with the Sixers.

He was featured alongside a profile written by new teammate LeBron James, who wrote his relationship with Maxey "definitely influenced my decision to come to Philadelphia and join the 76ers."

"He's just a joy to be around. It's up to us as his teammates to continue to push him to be as great as he can be. I'm happy to be a part of it," James wrote.

Manning, 22, made his appearance on the list after leading Texas to a 4-0 start to his second season as a full-time college starter.

His profile was written by actor and Longhorns fan Matthew McConaughey, who indicated he is expecting big things from Manning down an upcoming stretch featuring five straight games against ranked opponents.

"After a promising second half to last season, some added offensive weapons, and most importantly some time to settle into himself, the occasion for Arch's inner confidence to deal with the brightest lights has never been more lit," McConaughey wrote.

Miles, 23, was named the 2026 WNBA Rookie of the Year after leading the Lynx to the top seed in the WNBA playoffs while breaking Caitlin Clark's all-time rookie record for total points.

She was celebrated with a profile by WNBA legend Sue Bird, who complimented the Lynx rookie for bringing a new personal and playing style to the league.

"She has had such an impressive first year in the WNBA that you can imagine her having great individual success; you can imagine her winning championships," Bird wrote. "What's fun is that we get to watch her do it all in real time. Olivia is only just beginning to scratch the surface."

The honor came the day after the Lynx suffered an upset elimination loss to the Liberty in which Miles was held to just five points.

Balogun made the list after leading the United States on its run to the Round of 16 at the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Eala, who could take a step closer to qualifying for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics with a win at the 2026 Asian Games, was described as a "true phenomenon" in her accompanying profile by Rafael Nadal.

articles.title: Andy Burnham 'really concerned' if Man City owners sell up after rule breaches
articles.summary: The prime minister compares the allegations against Man City to the plight of his own club Everton.
articles.body:
Andy Burnham has said he would be "really concerned" if Manchester City's owners decide to sell up after the club was found guilty of Premier League financial rule breaches.

The prime minister said the situation was "contested by Manchester City" and he praised the club's owners since 2008 - led by Sheikh Mansour, United Arab Emirates deputy prime minister and royal family member - for investing in Manchester.

An independent commission found the club guilty of the majority of the 115 charges they faced , a verdict that City are expected to appeal.

The club continue to deny any wrongdoing and have until 2 October to submit an appeal.

It comes as the Independent Football Regulator – set up by the government in 2025 – said the case had raised "serious issues".

The regulator suggested it would be exploring options – including whether to strip the owners of their licence to own the club – once the disciplinary process was completed.

Among the independent panel's findings were that City arranged "sham contracts" with a number of commercial partners as part of a scheme to disguise secret funding of more than £830m.

The Premier League said City "systematically broke Premier League Rules for nearly a decade".

The independent panel will hold a sanctions hearing – which could take months to convene – to decide the punishment. City can appeal both the guilty verdicts and the sanction, leaving City and the league in a state of chaos and uncertainty.

The punishment could range from a huge fine, being deducted points or ejected from the Premier League, to being stripped of the eight trophies they had won in the affected period.

Some fans and pundits have questioned how the club's owners can carry on if they deliberately breached rules over the course of nine years.

Asked by the BBC's political editor Chris Mason if he was concerned that Manchester City's owners would now sell the club, Burham said on Wednesday: "I would be really concerned to lose them.

"They've been such a huge partner in the building of modern Manchester and obviously the building of Manchester City into the global force that it is."

Burnham, the mayor of Greater Manchester until June, added: "I do actually thank the City Football Group and the wider ownership for the money that they didn't just put into the Etihad [Stadium] and the campus around it but also into the city".

He said he was "of course" confident that his own interactions with City's owners when he was mayor would stand up to scrutiny.

Burnham made his comments amid widespread shock in football about the scale of the independent commission's findings – and the strength of Premier League comments about City's actions.

Burnham was speaking to the BBC from Hill Dickinson Stadium, the home of Everton, the team he supports.

Everton had their own run in with Premier League financial rules when they were charged and deducted 10 points for more minor breaches in November 2023, reduced to six on appeal.

Burnham said: "Everton was in this position a few years ago and you might remember that I fought for Everton in that situation because I still hold the view very firmly that they weren't fairly treated in that process."

Drawing a comparison between that and City's current predicament, he added: "I remember people proclaiming Everton guilty at the time and with hindsight I think more people would say that wasn't fair, the way that was handled.

"So it would be wrong of me to leap to one side given the experience that I'd had before becoming prime minister."

It is "frustrating when people rush to judgement", Burnham said.

He accepted there was "a lot at stake" for City fans, the club and Manchester itself.

But he added it would be wrong for him to intervene.

City have said in a statement they are "both disappointed and surprised by the opinion of the Premier League Commission" and maintained their innocence of all the accusations made.

articles.title: Manchester City charges: 'Business as usual' for women's team, says Andree Jeglertz
articles.summary: Manchester City manager Andree Jeglertz said it was "business as usual" for the women's team despite the Premier League charges against the club.
articles.body:
Manchester City manager Andree Jeglertz did not comment on whether he had received assurances that the women's team would not be impacted after the club was found guilty of Premier League financial breaches.

Jeglertz, who joined City last summer, said it was "business as usual" and when asked about how the women's team could be affected, added: "I don't want to comment more around that."

There were seven questions in total posed to Jeglertz relating to the charges before Manchester City's press officer requested the media moved away from it.

The club has been found guilty of all charges related to breaches of Premier League financial rules between the 2009-10 and 2017-18 seasons.

The Premier League said City arranged "sham contracts" with a number of commercial partners as part of a scheme to disguise secret funding of more than £830m.

The club continue to deny any wrongdoing and have until 2 October to submit an appeal.

The women's team were the first representatives of the club to address the media since the guilty charges were confirmed by the Premier League.

It is still unknown what impact the charges could have on the women's team, though BBC Sport understands there is no active investigation taking place from WSL Football.

The charges, which were breaches of Premier League rules, are different financial regulations to the WSL and they came at a time when the women's league was under the governing body of the Football Association.

There is no suggestion so far that any WSL opponents have expressed concern for City's charges, or whether they believe it has helped the women's team progress.

City defender Jade Rose said the women's players had received "the same messaging the public has" from the club.

When asked about the charges raising any concerns for the players, she added: "I'm just here to talk about the football. That's what we're focusing on."

The team took part in an open training session earlier on Wednesday morning and there did not appear to be any changes to their routine or behaviour.

Therese Sjogran, director of women's football at Manchester City, was in attendance for training, as she often is.

There were a few additional media in attendence for Jeglertz and Rose's press conference to preview their Women's Champions League game against Real Madrid.

Jeglertz responded to former men's manager Pep Guardiola's statement on social media, which voiced his support for the club.

Asked whether Jeglertz also stood beside the club, he said: "Definitely. I am working at the club now so that's who I am hired by and working with, so, for sure."

Jeglertz also said he did not find it more challenging to prepare for Thursday's game despite the noise surrounding the club.

"I don't think so. We have been training like normal and doing the work we can do to affect the game," he said.

"We haven't changed anything, we have just kept on doing everything we normally do. Definitely the thing the club has been presented, is the information we have inside of our group.

"We can't talk about anything else and we don't need to talk about anything else at the moment."

Jeglertz added that he was not frustrated by the negative media attention despite City's strong start to their WSL campaign.

The defending champions currently have 12 points from their opening four matches in the WSL and are top of the table.

They face Real Madrid on Thursday (20:00 BST) in their second Women's Champions League league phase match, having drawn their opener against Bayern Munich last week.

articles.title: Histórica foto oficial de Illes Balears Palma Futsal a bordo de la 'Balear'
articles.standfirst: En la barca de bou recuperada por el Consell de Mallorca testimonio vivo de la tradición marítima de la isla
articles.summary: En la barca de bou recuperada por el Consell de Mallorca testimonio vivo de la tradición marítima de la isla
articles.body: Construida en 1929, La Balear es un testimonio vivo de la tradición marítima de Mallorca. Su recuperación llevada a cabo por el Consell de Mallorca permite conservar y divulgar una parte esencial de la memoria marinera de la isla, convirtiéndola en un marco especialmente significativo para una fotografía destinada a representar al equipo durante toda la temporada. Sin ningún género de dudas, qué mejor escenario para que Illes Balears Palma Futsal se haya hecho esa fotografía oficial de la temporada 2026-27, sin ningún lugar de dudas, la histórica foto en la barca de bou refuerza el vínculo del club con la historia, la cultura y el patrimonio de Mallorca. La plantilla y Antonio Vadillo han sido recibidos por el vicepresidente segundo del Consell de Mallorca y consejero de Medio Ambiente, Medio Rural y Deportes, Pedro Bestard, y por el director insular de Deportes, Toni Prats, además de la alcaldesa de Andratx, Estefanía Gonzalvo, y el concejal de Deportes y Turismo del Ayuntamiento de Andratx, Lluís Antoni Sieiro. José Tirado ha encabezado la representación institucional del club en una jornada que ha permitido acercar al equipo a uno de los proyectos de recuperación patrimonial más singulares impulsados por el Consell de Mallorca. La única ausencia de la plantilla ha sido Luan Muller, que desde esta semana continúa en Brasil con el trabajo de recuperación de su lesión, en coordinación y con la autorización del club, después de haber permanecido durante el verano en Mallorca trabajando en su proceso de recuperación.

articles.title: Swiss Football Association withdraws support for FIFA boss Gianni Infantino
articles.summary: Executive committee reverses its support ‌for the Swiss football administrator after endorsing his candidacy in June.
articles.body:
The Swiss Football Association (SFV) has announced it is withdrawing its support for incumbent Gianni Infantino in next year’s FIFA presidential election.

Numerous leading European national associations have withdrawn their support for Infantino after he caused uproar in July with a proposal to sell off stakes of FIFA competitions – including the World Cup and Club World Cup – to private investors.

The SFV’s decision, announced on Wednesday, carries weight as Infantino is Swiss, and both FIFA and European football’s governing body UEFA are based in Switzerland.

The SFV said that its executive board met on Friday and “decided to withdraw the support it had declared in June 2026 for Gianni Infantino’s candidacy for a further term as FIFA president”.

Infantino’s plan would have allowed private investors to acquire stakes in a company created under the FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) initiative. The backlash that followed led to the proposals being quickly shelved.

SFV president Peter Knabel said Swiss football’s governing body expected FIFA’s leadership to uphold the highest standards of transparency, accountability and institutional responsibility.

“Key questions regarding the background, responsibilities and decision-making processes remain unanswered,” he said.

“As these have not been convincingly clarified, we cannot justify continuing to support Gianni Infantino’s candidacy.”

articles.title: Sneijder carga contra la Federación Neerlandesa por el fichaje de Xavi: "Me resulta extraño"
articles.standfirst: El exmadridista cuestiona que el español pueda dirigir a 'la Oranje' sin cumplir los mismos requisitos que los técnicos de Países Bajos
articles.summary: El exmadridista cuestiona que el español pueda dirigir a 'la Oranje' sin cumplir los mismos requisitos que los técnicos de Países Bajos
articles.body: A pesar de haber comenzado con buen pie al frente de 'la Oranje', con un empate (1-1) ante Alemania y una victoria frente a Serbia (1-2), el nombramiento de Xavi Hernández como seleccionador de Países Bajos ha sido duramente cuestionado por una de las grandes leyendas del fútbol neerlandés: Wesley Sneijder. El excentrocampista del Real Madrid, internacional con Países Bajos y jugador con más partidos en la historia de la selección, cargó contra la KNVB (Real Asociación Neerlandesa de Fútbol) por la elección del técnico español durante un programa de Riggo Sport. El motivo de su enfado está relacionado con los requisitos que exige la federación para obtener las licencias de entrenador en Países Bajos. Sneijder sostiene que antiguos futbolistas de élite neerlandeses son rechazados cuando solicitan realizar los cursos de entrenador, además de tener que completar un largo proceso de formación. En cambio, Xavi obtuvo sus credenciales a través de la Federación Española en un periodo mucho más corto. "Xavi completó los niveles A, B y Pro en cuatro semanas. Cuando todavía era jugador, a través de la federación española. Claro que las tiene, pero no según el estándar de la KNVB. Me parece extraño, porque básicamente dicen que todos los entrenadores deben cursar un programa de cuatro años y medio", explicó el exfutbolista. Sneijder también recordó su propio enfrentamiento con la federación: "Ahora contratan a alguien que no ha hecho nada de eso, con la excusa de que 'ha trabajado con grandes entrenadores'. No le guardo rencor a Xavi y le deseo lo mejor a la KNVB, pero me resulta extraño. En aquel momento dije: 'Busquemos una solución a medida'. Pero me ignoraron". La relación entre Sneijder y la KNVB viene de lejos. En 2021, el exinternacional neerlandés abandonó prematuramente su curso de entrenador después de un conflicto con los responsables de la federación. El exfutbolista consideró entonces que no se estaba teniendo en cuenta la experiencia acumulada durante su carrera al más alto nivel.

articles.title: Toché: “Aquí nadie tiene crédito infinito”
articles.standfirst: El director deportivo respalda a Alberto González, pero no garantiza su continuidad si el Alba cae ante el Eibar
articles.summary: El director deportivo respalda a Alberto González, pero no garantiza su continuidad si el Alba cae ante el Eibar
articles.body: Toché quiso dar la cara en el Carlos Belmonte ante un arranque liguero que él mismo calificó de “malísimo”. “No soy una persona que se esconde, quiero transmitirle a la afición que estamos preocupados por la situación, que sabemos que hemos tenido un comienzo de año bastante malo, que somos conscientes de ello y que trabajamos para cambiar esa situación”, explicó en una rueda de prensa. El director deportivo se colocó en el centro de la diana: “Desde la dirección deportiva, yo al mando, soy el máximo responsable de lo que está pasando y todos asumimos nuestra parte de responsabilidad”. Su mensaje a la afición fue de unidad: “Es el momento de estar unidos, el equipo está capacitado para darle la vuelta”. El respaldo a Alberto González es firme, pero no ilimitado. “Aquí nadie tiene crédito infinito, el día que no confíen en mí o el día que crean que estoy haciendo las cosas mal seré el primero en irme. Yo creo que todos tenemos un crédito limitado, tanto jugadores como el cuerpo técnico como yo”, advirtió Toché. Preguntado por si se plantearía irse con el entrenador en caso de que el club prescindiera de él por los resultados, fue tajante: “No, para nada, para nada”. Y a la duda de si la confianza en Alberto responde a motivos económicos quiso aclarar: “No, no tiene nada que ver su contrato, pues como todos los entrenadores, si despides a uno tienes que pagar el contrato entero”. Toché defendió que el Alba ha elegido un camino distinto al de otros: “Es cierto que en otro club quizá lo hubieran destituido hace, no sé si tres o dos jornadas pero esto es un club de proyecto, que cree en lo que hace, un club que transmite tranquilidad y gracias a esa tranquilidad creo que vamos a salir de esta situación”, y admitió que la salida fácil estaba a mano: “Yo podría haber ido a lo fácil, cesar a Alberto, traer a otro y lavarme las manos, pero creo que es una decisión valiente que seguir confiando en él y yo creo que está capacitado para dar la vuelta”. Esa confianza, sin embargo, está supeditada a los resultados. Preguntado por si puede garantizar la continuidad del técnico si el equipo pierde el sábado ante el Eibar, no lo hizo: “Eso no te lo puedo garantizar”, no obstante añadió: “Creo que Alberto es el más capacitado para hacerlo, ya lo ha hecho, ya lo hizo”. Preguntado por las causas de que el Alba sea colista, empezó por las bajas: “Creo que es cierto que la cantidad de bajas que hemos tenido han influido para no poder contar con todos, creo que ha sido un lastre durante estas jornadas”. Después apuntó a la defensa y a la falta de acierto: “Hemos sido frágiles en defensa y luego no hemos estado acertados de cara a gol”. Y sumó el factor anímico: “Cuando uno entra en una dinámica negativa todo cuesta más y eso solo se revierte pues ganando”. Las lesiones fueron el otro gran asunto. Toché sostuvo que hay lesiones imprevisibles: “Las lesiones de rodilla por traumatismos que hemos tenido cuatro o cinco, esas no se pueden prever”. Detalló que el club trabaja en ello: “Cada lesión tiene su por qué y estamos en ello, estamos trabajando en cambiar muchísimas cosas, tanto en el aspecto físico como técnico”. También recordó que “este año hemos incorporado otro preparador físico” y se mostró optimista: “Creo que esas lesiones no van a ser durante todo el año. Esperemos que a partir de ahora haya muchas menos lesiones”. Este sábado llega el Eibar al Carlos Belmonte, un partido que, para bien o para mal, significará un punto de inflexión.

articles.title: Luis García Plaza: "Ojalá acabemos arriba, pero tampoco tenemos que volvernos locos"
articles.standfirst: El entrenador del Sevilla reconoce que pidió una renovación profunda en la plantilla
articles.summary: El entrenador del Sevilla reconoce que pidió una renovación profunda en la plantilla
articles.body: Este miércoles, Luis García Plaza ha concedido una entrevista a Canal Sur Radio en la que ha podido repasar la actualidad del Sevilla y responder a diversas cuestiones. "Estoy tranquilo después de estos días. Es un parón muy raro y muy largo que nunca hemos tenido, pero creo que estamos entrenando bien y tenemos el trofeo de este viernes. Después ya afrontaremos la semana que viene. Hay que liberar la mente y entrenar, y creo que de momento estamos bien", arrancó el entrenador nervionense. 189 días en el Sevilla: "Nada más llegar la sensación era de un momento muy complicado. El equipo estaba muy tocado, lo notaba en los primeros días, pero entre todos, con el ánimo de la gente, los jugadores se concienciaron y en siete partidos ganamos cuatro, hasta que prácticamente conseguimos la salvación. Ha sido lo más intenso que he vivido en mi vida por espacio corto de tiempo. Cuando perdimos en Pamplona era muy complicado y al final se consiguió. A partir de ahí, la incertidumbre de si íbamos a seguir o no por la posible venta. Terminó la temporada y nos fuimos una semana cerca de Cádiz esperando al famoso 30 de mayo. Cuando me dijeron que no se hacía la venta, empezamos a trabajar para este año". Planificación: "Yo tenía en mi cabeza lo que queríamos para el equipo, pero después hay que hacerlo. No ha salido todo como queríamos, pero es lógico. Teníamos que hacer un cambio en el vestuario con gente nueva de una mentalidad diferente. Hemos conseguido en gran parte renovar y que se quede más o menos la gente que queríamos. A partir de ahí intentar comenzar el equipo, que no era fácil porque iba a haber muchas salidas". Exigencia: "Las posiciones son un poco anecdóticas porque ahora la separación entre los puestos de abajo y de arriba son muy pocos puntos. Ha habido un buen arranque, eso es innegable, no solo con puntos, sino con buenas sensaciones, aunque para mí el equipo tiene que crecer. Todavía hay mucho jugador joven que se está adaptando. A lo mejor sacas peores resultados, pero como entrenador veo que al equipo le faltan cosas que quiero. Tengo tranquilidad". Echar raíces: "El Sevilla es un gran equipo con solera, con historia y con títulos. Normalmente estás dos o tres años en los sitios, pero tenemos que vivir del día a día. En cuanto los resultados no sean buenos, sabemos lo que puede pasar. Ojalá se pueda construir algo y en un futuro el Sevilla vuelva a ser el de antes. A lo mejor no es este año, pero si no llega, que se sienten las bases para que pueda ser en poco tiempo otra vez ese Sevilla ganador". Objetivos: "Competir, intentar dar el máximo en cada partido, y cuando queden diez jornadas ver dónde estamos y a lo que podemos llegar. Ahora el equipo transmite muy buenas sensaciones, pero Primera división es muy dura, está muy igualada. Al principio esas diferencias no son tan grandes de puntos. Otro Sevilla con otro pedigrí hubiera apostado por otro entrenador. Entonces, a vivir el día a día y a disfrutar de este gran club y de esta ciudad. Ojalá podamos construir algo y acabemos arriba, pero todo tiene unos pasos, porque el año pasado estuvimos en el límite y tampoco tenemos que volvernos locos". Cambios: "El año pasado era salvarlo como sea, incluso tuve que hacer cosas que no haría en un equipo normal porque era una urgencia brutal. El día que se confirma que no hay venta, me reúno con el presidente y le digo que mi idea es renovar el vestuario, dentro de que hay jugadores que se tienen que quedar. Me dice: '¿Qué te parece José Ignacio?'. Le dije que encantado, ya estaba en el club y lo conoce. A partir de ahí, todo fue empezar. Se habla de los que han venido, pero Odysseas, Suazo, Castrín, Kike, Agoumé o Miguel Sierra estaban aquí. El año pasado no rindieron por A o por B y este año lo están haciendo". Vargas: "Está teniendo unos problemas físicos que ahora parece que arranca con el equipo. Es un jugador importante y espero sacar su mejor rendimiento. Tiene que coger ese punto de forma para entrar porque el equipo está funcionando. No está Rubén, Alfon no hizo pretemporada y salió Miguel, que está jugando bien. Cuantos más tengamos enchufados, mejor. Voy a hacer todo lo posible por recuperar a Rubén porque para mí es un jugador importante". Salida de Oso: "Fue un momento duro por el tema del partido, que fue un día antes, pero han venido nuevos jugadores y el equipo sigue. El otro día hablé con él, está adaptándose. Además, tengo un amigo común, Panichelli, que está con él y hablamos. Le deseo lo mejor. No es lo mismo tener una baja por lesión a que te lo quiten de la noche a la mañana. Creo que el equipo estuvo muy bien en esos partidos, con 6 puntos de 9. Después no ha llegado ese perfil, y como entrenador tengo que modificar cosas. En eso no soy cabezota. Oso nos hacía de quinto defensa y no ha venido un jugador así. Cuando ya se cierra el mercado, para mí son los mejores y tengo que sacarles rendimiento". Fichaje de Fofana: "Es una cosa que no esperábamos. El último día y medio nuestro fue frenético. Ya eran las 10 y algo, buscábamos un 6 o un 4 y, de pronto, nos aparece este jugador. José Ignacio estuvo rapidísimo y el presi estuvo muy bien". Del Nido Carrasco: "Hablo de mi experiencia de estos meses. El año pasado cuando me llaman es un momento muy crítico y ahí tanto el apoyo de Cordón a mi figura como del presidente fue muy bueno. Antonio nos dio mucha tranquilidad, a mí me dio mucha confianza. Creo que todo el mundo que ha construido este Sevilla ha hecho un buen trabajo". Renovación de Castrín: "Desde que llegué, en cuanto llevamos una semana dije: 'Ese chaval tiene que jugar'. Era una sensación que tenía. Creo que es un jugador que puede marcar un tiempo aquí. Estamos tranquilos, él y yo no hablamos de eso, hablamos de fútbol. Tuvo un verano complicado por un tema de pubis, pero lo superó y está rendiendo bien. Ojalá renueve". Enfoque: "Tenemos que tener claro lo que queremos hacer. Cuando se viene de dos años de sufrir simplemente hay que trabajar. Por ejemplo, arriba tenemos a Robbie que viene de una liga de mucho menos nivel, que es joven, y Lucas iba convocado con la sub-21. Tienen que crecer. Para están manteniendo el equipo los del año pasado con la aportación de los nuevos, quitando Fofana que es de otro nivel. Pero hasta que llegó, ganamos dos partidos con Nico y Manu, Guridi jugó de 8 y no estaba Kochorashvili tampoco".

articles.standfirst: El Comité de Cultura, Ciencia, Educación y Medios de Comunicación de la PACE muestra su inquietud por los problemas "de gobernanza e integridad" que rodean a la FIFA
articles.summary: El Comité de Cultura, Ciencia, Educación y Medios de Comunicación de la PACE muestra su inquietud por los problemas "de gobernanza e integridad" que rodean a la FIFA
articles.body: El Comité de Cultura, Ciencia, Educación y Medios de Comunicación de la PACE (Asamblea Parlamentaria del Consejo de Europa) ha expresado hoy en un comunicado su "profunda preocupación por los recientes problemas de gobernanza e integridad que rodean a la FIFA, los cuales plantean nuevas preguntas sobre transparencia, rendición de cuentas, derechos humanos y buena gobernanza". El Comité se refiere al proyecto FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE), "desarrollado al margen de los procedimientos de gobernanza establecidos" y que ilustra "la gravedad de estas preocupaciones y ha suscitado llamamientos a la rendición de cuentas por parte de confederaciones, asociaciones, jugadores, ligas, clubes y aficionados". El Comité entiende además la retirada del proyecto por parte de Infantino "no elimina las cuestiones sustantivas que planteaba ni las preocupaciones más amplias sobre la gobernanza y los procesos de toma de decisiones de la FIFA". "Refleja -añade el comunicado- un patrón más amplio de controversias en torno a la FIFA, lo que plantea interrogantes más profundos sobre la neutralidad política, la integridad y la protección de las decisiones deportivas y regulatorias de la FIFA frente a influencias políticas, personales o comerciales". El órgano del Consejo de Europa recuerda la polémica del Mundial con Balogun ya que "subraya aún más la importancia de salvaguardar la independencia y la credibilidad del proceso disciplinario de la FIFA". "El comité respalda las peticiones de una revisión externa independiente de su marco de gobernanza para las principales iniciativas estratégicas. Dicha revisión debe ser verdaderamente independiente, de alcance suficientemente amplio y generar recomendaciones concretas y un seguimiento efectivo", subraya el comunicado. El comité recuerda a su vez que se hace eco de la advertencia del Secretario General del Consejo de Europa a la FIFA sobre la creciente injerencia política, las apuestas y el poder financiero, y subraya la necesidad de establecer sólidas salvaguardias contra dichos riesgos: "La Conferencia de Ministros de Deportes que se celebrará en noviembre en Mónaco ofrece una importante oportunidad para abordar esta situación".

articles.title: Raúl Jiménez refuerza la portería del Inter JP Financial
articles.standfirst: Llega para suplir la baja de Jesús García, que tuvo que ser operado tras lesionarse en la muñeca
articles.summary: Llega para suplir la baja de Jesús García, que tuvo que ser operado tras lesionarse en la muñeca
articles.body: R Jiménez (Madrid, 3 de enero de 1996) es un portero curtido en mil batallas en el fútbol sala español. Formado en el UD Las Rozas Boadilla hasta juveniles, dio el salto al actual Magna Xota FS, con el que debutó en la máxima categoría con tan sólo 18 años. Tras tres temporadas en Anaitasuna (2014 a 2017) fichó por el Levante en el que jugó hasta la 2023-24 para recalar posteriormente en el Ribera Navarra. Ahora, Raúl Jiménez tiene un reto mayúsculo, ya que desde hoy, es nuevo jugador del Inter JP Financial. La lesión que hizo pasar por el quirófano a Jesús García, ha hecho que el club de Torrejón de Ardoz haya tenido que salir al mercado para incorporar al guardameta madrileño. Raúl Jiménez, se mostró emocionado en su presentación interista: "Es la ilusión de mi vida, pertenecer a un club como Inter, con tanta historia, tantos títulos… A nivel personal es una de las mejores cosas que te pueden pasar como futbolista. Estoy muy agradecido por la oportunidad". Competirá Raúl Jiménez con Jesús Herrero, al que admira: "Jesús Herrero ha sido un referente para mí y, ahora, tenerlo como compañero hará que aprenda mucho más. Somos muy parecidos". Es ambicioso desde el minuto cero: "Llevar esta camiseta es una responsabilidad en el día a día. Ojalá pueda levantar un día algún titulo con este club".

articles.title: Pau Quesada sitúa al Real Madrid en un segundo escalafón en la UWCL: "Estamos aquí para jugar partidos de máxima exigencia"
articles.standfirst: Coloca primero al Barcelona y OL Lyonnes y después al Manchester City, Bayern, Arsenal, Chelsea o PSG junto al conjunto blanco
articles.summary: Coloca primero al Barcelona y OL Lyonnes y después al Manchester City, Bayern, Arsenal, Chelsea o PSG junto al conjunto blanco
articles.body: El Real Madrid se enfrenta este jueves (21:00 horas) al Manchester City, actual campeón de la Liga inglesa, en la segunda jornada de la fase Liga de la Women's Champions League. Tras el empate ante el PSG en la primera fecha, el conjunto que dirige Pau Quesada visita la City sin mirar a la clasificación y con ganas de testar su nivel. "Es un partido de máxima exigencia, pero tenemos que ir a buscar los tres puntos. El año pasado ya vimos en este nuevo formato de Champions que lo que parece en un inicio luego no es y al revés. La dinámica (de la competición) es muy cambiante. No tenemos que pensar que ya tenemos la renta de un punto, sino que enfrente tenemos un gran rival. Estamos en la Champions para jugar este tipo de partidos", aseguró el técnico. Quesada colocó al City en el mismo nivel que a su equipo. "Si hiciéramos un ranking, a día de hoy, todo el mundo situaría al Barça y al OL Lyonnes por encima del resto. Después hay equipos como el Manchester City, el Bayern, el Arsenal, el Chelsea o el PSG en otro escalón donde también situaría al Real Madrid. Y luego habría una igualdad tremenda", resumió. "El City es un equipo que a mí me gusta mucho, a nivel asociativo tiene muchísimas capacidades y lo pongo entre los mejores del mundo", aseguró. El conjunto blanco llega a la cita invicto (seis victorias y dos empates) y mucho flow. "Tenemos que valorar el proceso del equipo, ese flow continuo. Venimos de jugar un partido donde el PSG nos generó sólo una oportunidad y media y ese es el camino que debemos continuar mañana [por el jueves]. Independientemente del resultado, tenemos muy claro el camino que queremos y el proceso que debemos seguir para crear ese equipo competitivo y que nos guste ver. Los que estamos en el día a día lo estamos disfrutando", destacó Pau. En lo deportivo cabe destacar el alta de Holmgaard, que llega justo para suplir la baja de Levels en el lateral izquierdo. Quesada tampoco podrá contar con Toletti, aunque sí con las mundialistas Sub’20: Laia, Cristóbal, Irune y Comendador. "Esperamos un partido muy entretenido de ver. Somos dos equipos que les gusta tener mucho el balón y atacar constantemente. Tendremos que controlar bien a sus jugadoras interiores porque tienen mucha calidad. Espero un partido igualado, como lo están siendo todos los de la Champions", sentenció.

articles.title: Man City charges: What if club's Premier League titles and trophies are stripped? Who 'benefits' and what changes?
articles.summary: Manchester City won three Premier League titles, one FA Cup, three League Cups and one Community Shield between the 2009/10 and 2017/18 seasons during which they committed serious breaches of Premier League financial rules; Man City deny the breaches and will appeal against the ruling
articles.body:
An independent commission found City guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules between the 2009/10 and 2017/18 seasons, during which the club won three Premier League titles, one FA Cup, three League Cups and one Community Shield.

Sanctions will be addressed in a further hearing with the independent commission and Man City, who continue to deny the breaches, have confirmed they will appeal against the ruling and have until Friday, October 2 to do so.

Possible sanctions include points deductions, fines, transfer bans and expulsion from the Premier League - but what if City are stripped of their titles and trophies?

If City are stripped of Premier League titles…

Man City won three Premier League titles between 2009/10 and 2017/18.

They pipped Manchester United on the final day of the season in 2012 through Sergio Aguero's famous winner, then they won the league by two points over Liverpool in 2014 before setting a new record in 2018 by amassing 100 points to deny United again.

So if the titles were awarded simply to the runners-up, Man Utd would be handed two, one each for Sir Alex Ferguson and Ole Gunnar Solskjaer, taking the club's Premier League total to 15, and Liverpool one - their second under Jurgen Klopp.

However, stripping City of their titles would not necessarily mean rewriting the league tables and promoting every club below them by one place. Instead, the titles could remain vacant, like when Juventus were stripped of the 2004/05 Serie A title for their involvement in the Calciopoli doping scandal, and it was left unassigned.

Another option could be to expunge Man City's league record - removing their results - between 2009/10 and 2017/18, which would impact teams' points total and even their finishing positions, although Man Utd and Liverpool would still replace them as title winners.

Blackpool , in the 2010/11 season, are the only club across the nine seasons that would technically have avoided relegation if Man City's results were removed, at Wolves' expense.

In four of the nine seasons that Man City have been found guilty of financial breaches, Everton missed out on European football because City finished above them in the Premier League.

In a fifth season, 2013/14, Everton finished fifth and qualified for the Europa League, when the top four - including champions City - qualified for the Champions League.

Tottenham , meanwhile, didn't qualify for the Champions League in four seasons during the period because City finished above them in the table. In each of those seasons, they played in the Europa League instead.

Man Utd, Arsenal and Chelsea missed out on Champions League football because City finished above them during the seasons in focus.

Liverpool, Man Utd, Swansea and Southampton were denied European qualification because City finished above them.

Tony Pulis was managing Stoke City when Man City beat them in the 2011 FA Cup final, winning their first major trophy in 35 years, and said he feels "cheated".

City also won three League Cups, beating Sunderland in 2014, Liverpool in 2016 and Arsenal in 2018 as well as Chelsea in the 2012 Community Shield.

Sunderland haven't won a trophy since the 1973 FA Cup, while Klopp was denied his first piece of silverware when City won on penalties at Wembley and Arsene Wenger was prevented from bowing out in style in his final season at Arsenal.

articles.title: Manchester City: Erling Haaland 'no different' following guilty verdict
articles.summary: Norway colleagues say the striker has been unaffected by the headlines around the Premier League club ahead of the Nations League game with Wales
articles.body:
Erling Haaland has been unaffected by the "sham contract" verdict against Manchester City, according to the Norway camp he's been with since the news broke.

Haaland will play for the first time since the Premier League's confirmation of City's financial rule breaches when Norway take on Wales in Cardiff on Thursday (19:45 BST).

The 26-year-old was kept away from the media before and after Norway's Nations League defeat by Portugal on Sunday after reports of City's guilty verdict first emerged.

As expected, Haaland was not put in front of the cameras as the World Cup quarter-finalists arrived in Wales amid headlines over his club and what next for the former champions, who continue to deny any wrongdoing.

Haaland signed for City in 2022, four years after the last of the nine seasons they were found to have broken financial rules, and is seen as their biggest star.

He trained as normal at Cardiff City Stadium on Wednesday evening, with Brentford defender Kristoffer Ajer saying Haaland had been "no different" since the news broke.

Live on BBC iPlayer, BBC Two Wales, BBC Sounds, BBC Radio Wales, Radio Cymru and 5 Live, BBC Sport website and app, plus live text commentary.

Manager Stale Solbakken attempted to deflect questions, tersely saying Haaland was "very good" and "scoring goals" before admitting he did miss one chance against Portugal he would normally have finished.

But asked if he had to speak to the forward because of the extra focus, Solbakken replied: "What we speak about is between him and me."

Ajer did offer more of an insight, saying Haaland remained fully focused halfway through this four-game Nations League window.

"He's been exactly the way he's always the same with the national team," said Ajer.

"He's truly focused on the upcoming games. I think he's trying to do the same as everyone else, wait and see what the outcome is - but right now the main focus is Wales tomorrow night. That's clearly been his way of doing it."

Asked if he had seen a difference in Haaland since the news broke, 59-cap Ajer said: "No not at all. Ever since I met him brings lot of energy and joy to the group.

"The biggest compliment I always give is that he hasn't changed a bit from the moment I met him even though he's the biggest star on the planet right now.

"He's been exactly the same the last few days as well which is not a surprise for me."

Questions about Wales form not unfair - Bellamy

Bellamy sure Wales belong as Haaland threat looms

Haaland - who scored in the 2-1 defeat by Portugal in Oslo and twice in the 3-2 win over Denmark to make it 65 in 57 appearances for his national side - could link up with Arsenal midfielder Martin Odegaard.

The Norway captain trained in Cardiff following the challenge from former Manchester City midfielder Bernardo Silva that was the subject of criticism on Friday night.

Solbakken praised Bellamy's impact on Wales, despite their winless run of six, saying he has "modern ideas" and suggested the side are simply low in confidence after missing out on a place in the summer's World Cup following a play-off defeat on penalties to Bosnia-Herzegovina.

Ajer added he could see similarities between the sides, saying: "It's a similar population and the same work ethic from both countries.

"So obviously we followed that journey Wales were on [in 2016] and obviously it was nice that it was our turn, so we're expecting a very, very tough game tomorrow with two equal sides that are playing the same kind of football."

articles.title: Kamario Taylor Rejected $4M Contract Offers to Transfer from Mississippi State, New Rumors Reveal
articles.summary: An early-season Heisman contender, Mississippi State quarterback Kamario Taylor decided against very lucrative NIL offers at the end of last season to remain with the Bulldogs.
articles.body:
An early-season Heisman contender, Mississippi State quarterback Kamario Taylor decided against very lucrative NIL offers at the end of last season to remain with the Bulldogs.

Per ESPN's Alex Scarborough , Taylor had offers in the range of $4 million from other schools in January that he "ignored" because he wants to honor his commitment to Mississippi State.

"They don't know the type of person I am," Taylor told Scarborough. "My mom always told me that once you start something, you have to finish it."

That's not to say Mississippi State doesn't intend to reward Taylor for his efforts. One person inside the program told Scarborough they plan to be "highly" aggressive to keep him in 2027.

"It's not a situation where we've got to have a bake sale to make Kamario Taylor happy at Mississippi State," MSU alum and lawyer Charlie Winfield said. "We're invested."

An offer in the $4 million range for Taylor at the end of last season speaks to how highly his talent was viewed because he did not play a lot as a freshman.

Fifth-year senior Blake Shapen was the Bulldogs' starter in 2025. Taylor, a 4-star recruit in the 2025 class, appeared in 11 games and started the final two games, including the Mayo Bowl against Wake Forest.

Taylor threw for 419 yards, ran for 236 yards and accounted for four touchdowns in those two games.

A $4 million deal would have made Taylor the sixth-highest-paid quarterback in FBS this season. The players at the top of the list are Miami's Darian Mensah (at least $6 million), Oregon's Dante Moore ($5 million), Mississippi's Trinidad Chambliss ($5 million), LSU's Sam Leavitt ($4.5 million) and Indiana's Josh Hoover ($4.5 million).

Taylor's performance so far this season has hit a point where Kansas City Chiefs star Chris Jones, who played at Mississippi State from 2013 to '15, recently said he plans to donate to the school's NIL to ensure the young quarterback doesn't go anywhere.

The sophomore star has thrown for 1,192 yards, 14 touchdowns and a 69.2 completion percentage in four games. He has also contributed 185 rushing yards and one touchdown on 37 carries.

Mississippi State has climbed up to No. 16 in the AP Top 25 poll amid a 4-0 start. It's tied for the program's highest ranking since the 2019 season.

This week is another chance for Taylor to enhance his Heisman case when the Bulldogs host No. 7 Alabama.

articles.title: Fabrizio Romano se sincera: “Puedes hacer que algunos acuerdos se caigan…”
articles.standfirst: El rey del mercado de fichajes habló en el MEO Arena durante el SBC Summit Lisboa sobre el poder de la información, la confianza, las redes sociales y todo el negocio que hay detrás
articles.summary: El rey del mercado de fichajes habló en el MEO Arena durante el SBC Summit Lisboa sobre el poder de la información, la confianza, las redes sociales y todo el negocio que hay detrás
articles.body: Hay una frase que millones de aficionados al fútbol esperan cada verano. Tres palabras, en realidad: “Here we go”. Cuando Fabrizio Romano las pronuncia, una operación que durante días ha vivido entre rumores, filtraciones y negociaciones pasa a otro nivel. Su firma se ha convertido en una referencia mundial del mercado de fichajes y en el centro de una audiencia que supera los 70 millones de seguidores en redes sociales. Pero detrás de esa velocidad existe una cuestión menos visible... el saber cuándo no publicar. Ese fue uno de los puntos más interesantes de la conversación que Romano tuvo en el MEO Arena de Lisboa. Bajo el título 'Here We Go: Trust, Speed and the Business of Breaking News', el periodista italiano explicó cómo construyó su marca y qué significa manejar información capaz de influir en el mercado. “A veces tienes que ser sensible porque importa el momento. Hay momentos en los que, si das a conocer la historia demasiado pronto, puede haber complicaciones. Puedes hacer que algunos acuerdos se caigan”, explicó. Para Romano, tener una información confirmada no significa necesariamente que haya que publicarla inmediatamente. En el mercado de fichajes, un jugador todavía puede estar negociando, un club puede estar tratando de cerrar los últimos detalles o una operación puede depender de una decisión que todavía no se ha tomado. Y ahí aparece una de las diferencias entre tener una exclusiva y saber utilizarla. Romano recordó durante la conversación un episodio ocurrido en los últimos días del mercado de verano de 2025. Tenía información sobre una operación que consideraba prácticamente cerrada, pero decidió esperar antes de utilizar su famoso 'Here we go'. “Estaba 100% seguro de la noticia, pero estaba esperando porque tenía la sensación de que el acuerdo todavía estaba al 90, no al 100%”, relató. Sin embargo, otros medios ingleses publicaron posteriormente información sobre la operación. Romano decidió entonces informar que el acuerdo estaba muy cerca de concretarse, aunque todavía no utilizaría su tradicional confirmación definitiva. Por eso, el periodista recordó que recibió entonces una llamada en el que le señalaron que su publicación podía afectar la operación. Aunque respondió que la información ya había sido difundida por otros medios, le advirtieron que la manera en que él presentaba la noticia podía tener un impacto diferente en la industria. La operación a la que hizo referencia estaba relacionada con Lucas Paquetá y el interés del Aston Villa por el jugador del West Ham. En aquel momento, el club inglés había negociado una posible cesión con obligación de compra, pero West Ham terminó rechazando la propuesta y Paquetá permaneció en el club... tras mandar un contundente mensaje al mundo de su negativa tras marcar un gol con su equipo. El episodio le sirvió a Romano para explicar algo que va más allá de una exclusiva. Detrás de cada fichaje hay personas, familias y planes de vida. “Imagina a la familia, o imagina lo que quieren hacer con sus planes para su vida. Estás arruinando sus planes”, señaló. Por eso, para él, el periodismo de fichajes exige algo más que velocidad. “Tienes que asegurarte de que el momento sea el correcto para ser preciso como periodista, pero también para asegurarte de que todos los involucrados estén conformes con lo que está sucediendo”, concluyó. Ese equilibrio entre velocidad y confianza es precisamente lo que ha permitido a Romano construir un modelo que va mucho más allá del periodismo tradicional. Su nombre ya funciona como una marca. El 'Here we go' es reconocible, sus publicaciones se consumen directamente en redes sociales y su audiencia supera los 70 millones de seguidores. Sin embargo, Romano se niega a que su audiencia tenga que pagar directamente por sus informaciones. “Siempre digo que no. Quiero que mi información sea completamente gratuita, pero con marcas que apoyen el enfoque”, afirmó. Su modelo pasa por mantener el acceso abierto y desarrollar colaboraciones comerciales alrededor de esa audiencia. “Creo que este es un sistema en el que todos ganan porque, al final del día, obviamente puedo trabajar de la mejor manera posible, las marcas pueden obtener exposición, pero también es una oportunidad perfecta para que las personas que quieren seguirme decidan por sí mismas qué hacer, sin pagar nada para acceder directamente a la información”, explicó. Las redes sociales también cambiaron lo que los aficionados esperan de la información. “Las redes sociales, en general, han empezado a cambiar completamente el enfoque”, explicó Romano. El aficionado ya no quiere saber únicamente quién ficha a quién. Quiere conocer el salario, las cláusulas, la duración del contrato, las condiciones del acuerdo y cada detalle que pueda explicar cómo se ha producido la operación. “Ahora mucha gente, especialmente las generaciones más jóvenes, sueña con los fichajes. Quieren saberlo todo”, afirmó. Para Romano, ese cambio ha transformado también la economía alrededor del mercado. “Si la gente está realmente metida en la atmósfera, significa que estás cambiando el sistema. Estás cambiando la economía del sistema”, señaló. Y ahí está una parte importante de su éxito: entendió que el mercado de fichajes podía dejar de ser una sección del periódico para convertirse en un contenido que se consume durante todo el día y directamente desde el teléfono. “Lo más importante es ser absolutamente neutral, hacer tu trabajo, mantener la calma e intentar dar lo mejor de ti, pero sin aceptar ningún tipo de condición externa, porque de lo contrario no eres profesional”, afirmó.

articles.title: Real Madrid are back: Liverpool star wanted in biggest deal yet
articles.summary: Real Madrid are back in for yet another Liverpool star. This would be their biggest move yet.Real Madrid have made a real habit of moving for out-of-contract...
articles.body:
Real Madrid are back in for yet another Liverpool star. This would be their biggest move yet.

Real Madrid have made a real habit of moving for out-of-contract Liverpool stars across the last few years. Much to the Reds' massive misfortune.

Honestly, it's not entirely clear why Liverpool are such a target for Los Blancos. Trent Alexander-Arnold went there on a free transfer in 2025, despite it being unclear whether they'd even use him.

Ibrahima Konate has followed in 2026. That was on the back of a pretty disappointing season from the Frenchman - though, virtually everyone at Anfield was disappointing last season.

Perhaps the logic is sound, though. Sign the centre-back Alexander-Arnold thrived playing alongside and you might get the best out of both of them.

But now they want to take it further than that.

Mundo Deportivo report that Real Madrid want Virgil van Dijk . The Liverpool captain's contract expires at the end of the season and it's unknown whether a new one is in the offing.

And so Real Madrid feel they could snap up another defender from Anfield here. It would mean potentially have three quarters of Liverpool's 2025 title-winning defence and raises questions about why they didn't move for Andy Robertson this year.

Competition will be there for Van Dijk, without question. He's one of the finest defenders to ever play the game and still performs at a world-beating level - his experience is unmatched and he can play for any side, essentially.

Real Madrid will fancy their chances, as they always do, but this is a player who hasn't ever really made any push to leave Liverpool. We're not sure he's even been seriously linked away, even during his contract talks two years ago.

Alessia Russo and Georgia Stanway struck either side of half time to put the north London side in control heading into the closing stages.

However, Renée Slegers' outfit couldn't see out the win and conceded twice in the final 20 minutes, including from a controversial penalty conceded by Leah Williamson for handball.

As a result, Arsenal let victory slip following a two-goal lead in the Champions League for the second time in two seasons - a feat they hadn't seen in 24 years previously.

articles.body:
Texas athletic director Chris Del Conte wasn't pleased with the actions of edge Colin Simmons and running back Raleek Brown during Saturday's win over Tennessee. During the contest, both players engaged in what Del Conte referred in his Tuesday newsletter as "inappropriate celebrations."

In that newsletter, Del Conte made it clear that those types of celebrations will not be tolerated by the program , per 247sports.com.

"We can all agree it was a heck of a game and an incredible performance on the field, but I also know we had some major issues to address with inappropriate celebrations from our players. Del Conte then apologized to the Longhorns community for the actions of both Simmons and Brown. Del Conte said both players have learned from their mistakes and will "grow from this."

Simmons found himself at the center of the controversy Saturday after he celebrated a sack by " simulating using the restroom ," referee Kyle Olson announced. Simmons mimicked urinating on the field during his celebration, which earned him a flag for unsportsmanlike conduct.

Brown came under fire for a celebration after his fourth-quarter touchdown. Brown appeared to wipe his genitals with his hand and then mimic fainting when he brought his hand up to his face. Brown's celebration was not flagged.

After the contest Saturday, Simmons apologized for his actions, saying he got caught up in the moment. On Monday, Sarkisian said he addressed both celebrations with the players, telling reporters, " that behavior is unacceptable. "

Del Conte let Texas supporters know he agreed with that sentiment Tuesday.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Portugal captain decides to national team leave camp amid reported rift with head coach Jorge Jesus
articles.summary: Portugal's captain announces he has walked out of the camp "following the national team manager's press conference" in a post on Instagram following reports of a rift between the pair; Portugal boss Jorge Jesus denied there was an incident after he left Ronaldo on the bench vs Norway
articles.body:
Reports of a rift between Ronaldo and Portugal's new head coach Jorge Jesus emerged after the six-time Ballon d'Or winner was left as an unused substitute in Sunday's Nations League win over Norway.

Jesus, who was Ronaldo's coach at Al Nassr, insisted "there was no incident whatsoever" in his press conference on Wednesday, claiming the star was set to return to training with his team-mates.

However, Ronaldo announced he had walked out on Portugal's camp later on Wednesday in a cryptic post on Instagram.

The 41-year-old wrote: "Following the national team manager's press conference, and after a conversation with the President of the Portuguese Football Federation, I decided to leave the national team's training camp.

"In due course, I will tell the Portuguese people the truth about the reasons behind my departure from the national team, to which I have always been dedicated.

"Now is the time to wish good luck to Portugal and to all my teammates, without exception."
